description: The Desk tab as the app reads it (GET desk). picks: the open Desk picks whose real Grade is B or better (B, B+, A-, A, A+), each with label, matchup, book, price, edge, paper stake in units, bet link and grade {letter, score, jobId, report: true}; picks with no Grade yet or a lower Grade are not on the Desk. Optional placed: pick ids the customer placed, returned as bets (open or settled) with their Grade whatever its letter. record: every settled Desk pick. Pro and up get the picks; Free and Starter get locked rows (league and start time only), the same count, and the record. Reads only; nothing is placed.
name: get_desk
title: Read the Desk
